title: Basic Muffin Mix
description: A simple, dependable base recipe — sweet or savoury, load it up any way you like.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 180°C. Grease a 12-cup muffin tin or line with paper liners.
In a large bowl, mix the self-raising flour, plain flour, sugar, and salt. Add your chosen additions and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the oil, egg, and milk until well combined. Add vanilla extract if making sweet muffins.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Mix gently with a spatula until just combined — the batter should be slightly lumpy. Do not overmix or the muffins will be tough.
Divide the mixture evenly between the muffin cups, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake for 18–22 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean and the tops are golden and spring back when lightly touched.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

notes.title: Don't Overmix
notes.content: The secret to tender muffins is gentle mixing. Lumpy batter is perfect — overmixing develops gluten and makes muffins tough and dense.

notes.title: Chocolate Chip Trick
notes.content: Toss chocolate chips in a little plain flour before adding to the batter. This prevents them from sinking to the bottom during baking.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Microwave for 10–20 seconds before serving for that fresh-from-the-oven warmth.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Store in an airtight container for 2–3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
